subject: english
question:
Which part of the following sentence contains a spelling error?

The prodigious violinist captivated audiences worldwide (1) with performances that were technically precise (2) and emotionally transcendant (3) in every respect (4).
solution:
The correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'transcendant'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling is 'transcendent'.**
 
• The word '**transcendent**' is an **adjective** that means 'surpassing ordinary limits or being exceptional'. **(उत्कृष्ट)**
 
 
• **For Example -** The artist's transcendent performance left the audience in awe.
 
 

Therefore, the correct part of the sentence with the spelling error is option **3 - transcendant.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Explanation of the other options -**

 
• **Option 1 -** 'The prodigious violinist' is correct and has no spelling errors.
 
• **Option 2 -** 'with performances that were technically precise' is correct and has no spelling errors.
 
• **Option 4 -** 'in every respect' is correct and has no spelling errors.
